intent.raw_query: Maldives honeymoon for 2, $5000 budget, snorkeling and luxury resorts, March 2026

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dolphin Cruise
experiences.description: Embark on an exclusive private dhoni boat cruise at sunset, sailing through the Indian Ocean while spotting spinner dolphins in their natural habitat. Sip champagne with your partner as the sky turns golden, creating an unforgettable romantic moment perfect for honeymooners.

experiences.name: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari
experiences.description: Explore vibrant coral gardens teeming with sea turtles, reef sharks, manta rays, and hundreds of tropical fish species. A guided snorkeling safari takes you to the most pristine and biodiverse house reefs in the atolls, with equipment provided and a marine biologist on hand to narrate the underwater world.

experiences.name: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two
experiences.description: Indulge in a couples' spa ritual at a world-renowned overwater spa with a glass floor, allowing you to watch fish glide beneath you as you receive traditional Maldivian massages using coconut oil and local botanicals. This ultra-luxurious experience is the pinnacle of honeymoon pampering.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, South Ari Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Private Sandbank Picnic Dining
experiences.description: Be whisked away by speedboat to a secluded uninhabited sandbank in the middle of the turquoise lagoon. A private chef sets up a gourmet candlelit lunch with fresh Maldivian seafood, tropical fruits, and chilled wine — just you, your partner, and the endless ocean horizon.

experiences.name: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class
experiences.description: Visit the inhabited local island of Maafushi to experience authentic Maldivian culture — explore a traditional fishing village, visit a local mosque, and join a hands-on cooking class where you learn to prepare classic dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut) and garudhiya fish soup using age-old recipes.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Maldives
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

experiences.name: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class
experiences.description: Visit the inhabited local island of Maafushi to experience authentic Maldivian culture — explore a traditional fishing village, visit a local mosque, and join a hands-on cooking class where you learn to prepare classic dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut) and garudhiya fish soup using age-old recipes.

day_by_day.morning: N/A - Flight arrives at 22:30
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A - In transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30 via Flight UA. Clear immigration and customs, then arrange a speedboat or local ferry transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in to your Beachfront accommodation, freshen up, and take a quiet stroll along the beach under the stars to soak in the first magical moments of the Maldives.

meals.breakfast: On the plane
meals.lunch: On the plane
meals.dinner: Grab a light snack or quick bite at the airport before boarding your transfer — try a local short-eat like 'Bajiya' (fish pastry) from an airport café for around $3–5.

day_by_day.notes: Pre-arrange your resort transfer before arrival to avoid delays at night. Keep essentials like swimwear and a change of clothes in your carry-on for easy access. Exchange some USD to MVR (Maldivian Rufiyaa) at the airport for local purchases.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely morning after your late arrival. After waking up, take your first swim in the crystal-clear lagoon right off the Aegean Bliss Resort beachfront. Explore the resort grounds, locate the house reef entry point, and get acquainted with the snorkeling gear available for rent or included in your package.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head out for your first snorkeling session at the resort's house reef. Spot colorful reef fish, sea turtles, and vibrant coral formations just steps from your beach. Ask resort staff about the best snorkeling spots and tide timings for maximum visibility. Spend 2–3 hours exploring the underwater world at your own pace.
day_by_day.evening: Watch a breathtaking Maldivian sunset from your beachfront room or the resort's beach. Enjoy a romantic walk along the shoreline as the sky turns shades of orange and pink. Dine at the resort's most affordable dining option — typically a casual beach grill or café.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast buffet if included in your package — enjoy tropical fruits, eggs, and local Maldivian 'Mas Huni' (tuna and coconut) for an authentic start.
meals.lunch: Pack a light picnic from the resort's grab-and-go counter or enjoy a simple fish sandwich and fresh coconut water at the beach café (~$8–12).
meals.dinner: Dine at the resort's casual beach grill — opt for grilled fish of the day with rice and salad (~$15–20 per person). Share a mocktail to keep costs down.

day_by_day.notes: Day 2 is your recovery and orientation day. Don't overplan — rest is essential after a late-night arrival. Check the resort's activity board for free or low-cost daily events like guided snorkeling tours or cultural presentations.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a sunrise yoga session on the beach (often offered free or at low cost by budget resorts). After yoga, enjoy breakfast and then rent a snorkel set if not already done. Head to a nearby sandbank — ask the resort to arrange a short boat trip to a local sandbank (~$10–15 per person) for an iconic Maldivian experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at the sandbank — swim, sunbathe, take photos, and enjoy the surreal feeling of standing in the middle of the Indian Ocean on a tiny strip of white sand. Return to the resort by mid-afternoon and relax in a hammock or by the lagoon.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic sunset cruise if offered by the resort at a budget price (~$20–30 per couple). Many resorts offer shared sunset dhoni (traditional boat) trips. Watch for dolphins, which are commonly spotted in Maldivian waters at dusk.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — tropical fruit platter, local flatbread (Roshi) with tuna curry, and fresh juice.
meals.lunch: Pack sandwiches and snacks from the resort to enjoy on the sandbank — saves money and adds to the picnic romance.
meals.dinner: Try the resort's set dinner menu if available — a fixed-price 3-course meal is often more budget-friendly (~$25–35 per person). Look for local fish dishes like 'Garudhiya' (fish broth) or grilled snapper.

day_by_day.notes: Sandbank trips are highly weather-dependent. Confirm with the resort the evening before. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a hat, and plenty of water — there is no shade on sandbanks. A waterproof phone case is a great investment for photos.

day_by_day.morning: Join the Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class on the local island of Maafushi (or nearest inhabited island). Take a local ferry or shared speedboat transfer (~$5–10 each way). Explore the island on foot — visit the local mosque, fishing harbor, and traditional homes. Learn about Maldivian history and daily life from local guides.
day_by_day.afternoon: Participate in the hands-on Maldivian Cooking Class — learn to prepare traditional dishes like Mas Riha (fish curry), Roshi (flatbread), and Bondi (sweet coconut rice balls). Cook alongside locals and enjoy the meal you've prepared together — a wonderfully romantic and immersive experience.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort via ferry by late afternoon. Freshen up and enjoy a quiet, romantic evening on your beachfront. Lay out a sarong on the beach and stargaze — the Maldives offers some of the clearest night skies in the world, with minimal light pollution.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast before heading out — fuel up for the day trip.
meals.lunch: Lunch is typically included in the Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class package — enjoy the authentic Maldivian meal you cooked yourself.
meals.dinner: Pick up affordable local snacks and fresh fruit from Maafushi's local shops before returning, or dine at the resort's casual café (~$10–15 per person for a simple fish and rice meal).

day_by_day.notes: Maafushi is a local island — dress modestly (cover shoulders and knees) when outside the resort area as a sign of cultural respect. This is one of the most budget-friendly and authentic experiences available in the Maldives. Booking the cooking class in advance is recommended.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicate the morning to an extended snorkeling session at the house reef or a nearby reef recommended by resort staff. Bring an underwater camera or GoPro to capture the marine life — look for manta rays, reef sharks, and sea turtles. Snorkeling is free if gear is included with your stay, making it the ultimate budget luxury activity.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a self-guided kayaking trip around the resort's lagoon (kayak rental ~$10–15/hour or free with some packages). Paddle to nearby shallow reefs or simply enjoy the calm turquoise waters. Spot starfish and small reef fish through the crystal-clear water from your kayak.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange a private beach dinner setup if your budget allows — many resorts offer this for a special occasion surcharge (~$30–50 extra). Alternatively, create your own romantic moment by buying candles and tropical flowers from the resort shop and setting up your own beachfront dinner spot.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — try local 'Fihunu Mas' (grilled fish) if offered, a traditional Maldivian breakfast staple.
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the beach café — fresh coconut, fruit salad, and a fish wrap (~$8–10).
meals.dinner: Romantic beachfront dining at the resort — opt for the grilled seafood platter to share, paired with mocktails or fresh lime juice (~$30–40 for two).

day_by_day.notes: Friday is the Maldivian weekend — local islands observe Jumu'ah (Friday prayers) and some services may be limited on nearby local islands. Stay resort-based today. Check if the resort offers any complimentary Friday evening entertainment or cultural performances.

day_by_day.morning: Join a guided snorkeling excursion to a nearby coral reef or protected marine area arranged through the resort (~$20–30 per person for a shared group trip). Experienced guides will point out rare marine species, coral gardens, and underwater formations you might miss on your own.
day_by_day.afternoon: Relax and indulge in a budget-friendly spa treatment — many Maldivian resorts offer introductory or shorter treatments at lower prices. Look for a 30-minute couple's massage or a traditional Maldivian coconut oil treatment (~$40–60 for a shorter session vs. $150+ for full treatments). Spend the rest of the afternoon reading by the beach.
day_by_day.evening: Take a moonlit walk along the beach. If the tide is right, look for bioluminescent plankton that light up the shoreline in a magical blue glow — one of the Maldives' most spectacular natural phenomena, completely free to experience.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — fresh papaya, scrambled eggs, and local tuna curry.
meals.lunch: Budget-friendly lunch at the resort's casual outlet — fish and chips or a fresh salad (~$10–12).
meals.dinner: Try a themed dinner night at the resort if offered (e.g., seafood BBQ buffet nights are common on weekends and offer great value at ~$25–35 per person with multiple dishes).

day_by_day.notes: Bioluminescent plankton sightings depend on water temperature and plankton blooms — ask resort staff if conditions are favorable. The best viewing is on darker nights away from resort lighting. This is one of the most romantic free experiences in the Maldives.

day_by_day.morning: Midpoint of your trip — take a half-day excursion to a nearby uninhabited island for a private picnic experience. Many resorts can arrange this for ~$20–40 per couple including boat transfer. Bring snorkeling gear and explore the reef around the uninhabited island, which is often untouched and teeming with marine life.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and spend a leisurely afternoon at the beach. Try stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) if available (~$15/hour) — it's a fun and easy activity even for beginners and offers a unique perspective of the lagoon.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate the halfway mark of your trip with a special dinner. Check if the resort has a promotion or set menu deal. Alternatively, visit a local guesthouse restaurant on a nearby local island for authentic Maldivian food at a fraction of resort prices (~$5–10 per person for a full local meal).

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — fuel up before the island excursion.
meals.lunch: Packed picnic lunch on the uninhabited island — arrange with the resort the night before. Typically includes sandwiches, fruit, and drinks.
meals.dinner: Local guesthouse restaurant on Maafushi or nearest local island — try 'Mas Huni and Roshi' or 'Tuna Curry with Rice' for an authentic and budget-friendly Maldivian dinner (~$5–8 per person).

day_by_day.notes: Visiting a local guesthouse restaurant requires a short boat or ferry trip. Confirm return ferry times before heading out for dinner. Always carry some MVR cash on local islands as many small eateries don't accept credit cards.

day_by_day.morning: Take an early morning fishing trip with local fishermen — a traditional Maldivian experience often available through the resort or local operators (~$15–25 per person). Learn traditional hand-line fishing techniques and try to catch your own breakfast. This is a wonderfully authentic and budget-friendly activity.
day_by_day.afternoon: If you caught fish in the morning, ask the resort kitchen to prepare it for you (small cooking fee may apply) — eating your own catch is a uniquely memorable experience. Spend the afternoon snorkeling or simply relaxing in the lagoon, floating in the warm, clear water.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a quiet, romantic evening in your beachfront room. Order room service if budget allows, or pick up snacks and drinks from the resort's mini-mart to enjoy on your private beach. Watch the stars together from your beach loungers.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast before the early fishing trip — grab fruit and a coffee from the resort café.
meals.lunch: Your freshly caught fish prepared by the resort kitchen with rice and salad — a truly unique dining experience (~$5–10 cooking fee).
meals.dinner: In-room dining or beach snack setup — pick up local snacks, fresh fruit, and drinks from the resort shop for a cozy private evening (~$10–15).

day_by_day.notes: Early morning fishing trips typically depart around 5:30–6:00 AM to coincide with the best fishing times. Book the evening before. Even if you don't catch anything, the sunrise on the water makes the early wake-up completely worthwhile.

day_by_day.morning: Explore a different snorkeling site today — ask the resort to recommend a drift snorkeling spot where currents carry you gently along the reef (suitable for confident swimmers). Drift snorkeling offers a unique, effortless way to see large sections of reef and encounter pelagic fish like barracuda and jackfish.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the resort's marine biology center or environmental station if available — many Maldivian resorts have coral restoration programs where guests can plant coral fragments for a small donation (~$10–20). This is a meaningful, hands-on conservation experience and a wonderful honeymoon memory.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a couple's sunset photography session on the beach — use your phone or camera and take turns photographing each other in the golden hour light. The Maldivian sunset provides a naturally stunning backdrop that rivals any professional shoot. Share a fresh coconut on the beach as the sun sets.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — try 'Dhon Riha' (sweet fish curry) if offered for a uniquely Maldivian morning.
meals.lunch: Beach café lunch — grilled fish burger and a fresh fruit smoothie (~$10–12).
meals.dinner: Resort dinner — try the catch of the day special, which is typically the freshest and most affordable option on the menu (~$18–22 per person).

day_by_day.notes: Coral planting programs must be booked in advance. Check with the resort's dive or marine center. Participation in conservation activities is a growing trend in Maldivian tourism and adds a meaningful dimension to your honeymoon experience.

day_by_day.morning: Take a full-day island hopping excursion — a shared group tour visiting 3–4 nearby islands including a local island, a sandbank, and a snorkeling spot (~$40–60 per person for a full-day shared tour, one of the best value activities in the Maldives). Depart after breakfast and spend the morning on the first island.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the island hopping tour — snorkel at a pristine reef, visit a second sandbank, and explore a local fishing village. Observe traditional boat-building (dhoni making) if available and interact with friendly local communities.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by late afternoon, tired but exhilarated. Enjoy a long, relaxing shower and a slow evening. Treat yourselves to a special dessert at the resort — Maldivian 'Bondi' (sweet coconut balls) or a tropical fruit platter to end the day on a sweet note.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — eat well before the full-day excursion.
meals.lunch: Lunch is typically included in full-day island hopping tours — usually a fresh seafood BBQ on a sandbank or local island (~included in tour price).
meals.dinner: Light dinner at the resort after the long day — a simple pasta or noodle dish and fresh juice (~$12–15 per person).

day_by_day.notes: Full-day island hopping tours are best booked 1–2 days in advance through the resort or a local tour operator. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a hat, extra water, and a dry bag for your valuables. This is one of the most comprehensive and budget-friendly ways to experience the diversity of the Maldives.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a slow, peaceful morning — your second-to-last full activity day. Sleep in, have a leisurely breakfast, and spend the morning swimming and floating in the lagoon. Reflect on your trip and soak in the beauty of your surroundings without any agenda.
day_by_day.afternoon: Try a beginner's introduction to scuba diving if you haven't already — many Maldivian resorts offer a 'Discover Scuba Diving' experience for non-certified divers (~$80–100 per person including equipment and instructor). This is a splurge but offers an unparalleled underwater perspective and is a once-in-a-lifetime honeymoon experience.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic farewell-to-the-sea dinner on the beach. Ask the resort to set up a simple beachside table for two at sunset. Share your favorite memories from the trip over dinner and toast to your honeymoon with a special mocktail or fresh fruit juice.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — enjoy every last bite of the tropical spread.
meals.lunch: Light beach café lunch — fresh fruit, yogurt, and a cold drink (~$8–10).
meals.dinner: Special beachside dinner for two — splurge slightly on this penultimate evening (~$40–50 for two with a shared seafood dish and dessert). Worth every penny as a honeymoon memory.

day_by_day.notes: The Discover Scuba experience is weather and sea-condition dependent. Book it the day before to confirm availability. Even if scuba diving is a stretch for the budget, the experience of breathing underwater in the Maldives is transformative and highly recommended at least once.

day_by_day.morning: Final full day — make the most of it with one last extended snorkeling session at your favorite reef spot. Take your time, say goodbye to the fish and turtles you've come to recognize, and capture final underwater memories. Snorkeling at dawn offers the calmest water conditions and most active marine life.
day_by_day.afternoon: Pack your bags and organize souvenirs. Visit the resort's gift shop for budget-friendly Maldivian keepsakes — locally made coconut shell crafts, reef-safe magnets, or Maldivian spice packs (~$5–15 each). Take a final walk around the resort grounds and beach, photographing your favorite spots.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy your last Maldivian sunset from the beach with a fresh coconut in hand. Have a final dinner at the resort and ask the staff to recommend a traditional Maldivian dessert to end your trip on a sweet, authentic note. Tip your resort staff if the service was excellent — a small gesture that goes a long way.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — savor your last tropical breakfast spread.
meals.lunch: Beach café lunch — keep it light and easy on the last full day (~$8–12).
meals.dinner: Final resort dinner — order your favorite dish from the trip or try something you haven't yet. End with a traditional Maldivian dessert like 'Dhonkeyo Kajuru' (banana fritters) or 'Foni Boakibaa' (sweet fish cake) (~$20–25 per person).

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your checkout time and transfer arrangements to the airport for the following day. Settle any outstanding resort bills tonight to avoid a rushed morning. Pack your snorkeling gear last so it's accessible if you want one final swim in the morning.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early for one last sunrise on the beach — a quiet, romantic moment to cherish as your Maldives honeymoon comes to a close. Take a final dip in the lagoon, breathe in the salt air, and take mental photographs of the paradise you're leaving behind.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort and arrange your speedboat or ferry transfer to Velana International Airport. Arrive at the airport with ample time (at least 3 hours before international departure). Browse duty-free shops for last-minute gifts — Maldivian black coral jewelry, locally produced honey, or traditional lacquerware.
day_by_day.evening: Board your departure flight. Reflect on 13 incredible days of snorkeling, romance, culture, and natural beauty in one of the world's most stunning destinations. Your budget-conscious Maldives honeymoon has proven that paradise doesn't have to break the bank.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast before checkout — eat well for the journey ahead.
meals.lunch: Airport restaurant or café — grab a meal before your flight. Try one last Maldivian short-eat like 'Gulha' (fish-stuffed dumplings) from an airport café (~$5–8).
meals.dinner: On the plane — or at a layover airport restaurant if your flight schedule allows.

day_by_day.notes: Budget Summary Estimate for 13 Days (per couple): Accommodation (Aegean Bliss Resort beachfront, 12 nights): varies by booking — look for early-bird or off-peak rates. Activities & Excursions: ~$300–450 total for both. Meals (mix of resort and local): ~$400–600 total for both. Transfers & Local Transport: ~$80–120 total. Souvenirs & Miscellaneous: ~$50–100. Total Estimated Trip Cost (excluding flights): ~$1,500–2,500 for two, making this a genuinely budget-conscious Maldives honeymoon.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — late-night arrival
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — late-night arrival
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Malé International Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Clear immigration and customs, then meet the Aegean Bliss Resort transfer representative. Board the resort's speedboat or seaplane transfer to the resort. Check in, receive a warm welcome drink and flower lei, and settle into your Beachfront villa. Enjoy a light late-night welcome amenity prepared by the resort.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable (in-flight or airport)
meals.lunch: Not applicable (in-flight or airport)
meals.dinner: Light welcome snack platter and tropical fruit basket provided by Aegean Bliss Resort upon arrival in your villa

day_by_day.notes: Given the 22:30 arrival, expect to reach the resort between 11:30 PM and midnight depending on transfer type. Confirm speedboat vs. seaplane transfer with the resort in advance — nighttime seaplane transfers are not available, so a speedboat is likely. Pack a light carry-on snack for the journey. Unpack minimally and rest up for your first full day in paradise.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and ease into island life. Enjoy a leisurely beachfront breakfast at the resort's main restaurant. Take a slow morning stroll along your private beach, dip your toes in the lagoon, and familiarise yourself with the resort's amenities — pool, spa, water sports centre, and beach bar.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the resort's house reef for your first snorkeling session. Rent snorkeling gear from the water sports centre and explore the vibrant coral formations just steps from your beachfront villa. Look out for colourful reef fish, sea turtles, and small reef sharks. Return to the beach for a relaxing sunbathing session with a refreshing mocktail or cocktail from the beach bar.
day_by_day.evening: Watch your first Maldivian sunset from the beach with a sundowner drink. Freshen up at the villa and head to the resort's overwater restaurant for a romantic dinner for two. Choose from fresh Maldivian seafood and international cuisine. Stroll along the illuminated jetty after dinner under a sky full of stars.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort's main restaurant — fresh tropical fruits, eggs made to order, pastries, and local Maldivian breakfast items like mas huni (tuna and coconut)
meals.lunch: Casual beachside lunch at the resort's beach bar — grilled fish sandwich, fresh salads, or a light pasta dish (mid-range pricing, approx. $25–$40 per person)
meals.dinner: Overwater restaurant at Aegean Bliss Resort — grilled lobster or catch-of-the-day with a bottle of house wine (approx. $60–$90 per person)

day_by_day.notes: This is your first full day — keep it relaxed and unhurried. Jet lag may still be a factor. Ask the resort's dive centre to brief you on the best snorkeling spots around the house reef. Request a sunset-facing table for dinner when you make your reservation in the morning.

day_by_day.morning: Book the Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari for the morning. Embark on a guided snorkeling excursion to nearby coral gardens teeming with sea turtles, reef sharks, manta rays, and hundreds of tropical fish species. The safari typically includes 2–3 snorkeling stops across different reef systems, with a knowledgeable marine biologist guide providing insights on the local ecosystem.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort by early afternoon. Enjoy a light lunch, then spend the afternoon at the resort pool with a good book or simply lounging on your beachfront terrace. Optional: visit the resort's spa for a solo relaxation treatment such as a traditional Maldivian coconut oil massage (approx. $80–$120 for 60 minutes).
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic beachside dinner under the stars at the resort's beach dining setup or the main restaurant. If the resort offers a bonfire beach dinner option, this is a perfect evening to book it. End the night with a moonlit walk along the water's edge.

meals.breakfast: À la carte breakfast at the resort — avocado toast, fresh juice, and local roshi (flatbread) with tuna curry
meals.lunch: Light poolside lunch — club sandwich, tropical fruit platter, and fresh coconut water (approx. $20–$35 per person)
meals.dinner: Beachside dining at Aegean Bliss Resort — Maldivian-style grilled fish with coconut rice and a tropical dessert (approx. $55–$80 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Book the Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari through the resort's activities desk at least one day in advance. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a rash guard, and an underwater camera or GoPro to capture the marine life. The safari typically departs at 8:00–9:00 AM. March is an excellent time for snorkeling with good visibility and calm seas.

day_by_day.morning: Experience the Underwater Spa Treatment for Two — indulge in a couples' spa ritual at the resort's world-renowned overwater spa. The glass floor allows you to watch fish and marine life swimming beneath you as you enjoy your treatment. Choose from a range of couples' rituals including body wraps, aromatherapy massages, and facial treatments. This is a signature honeymoon experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: After your spa morning, enjoy a leisurely lunch at the resort. Spend the afternoon kayaking or stand-up paddleboarding around the lagoon — equipment available from the water sports centre at no extra charge or for a modest fee. Alternatively, relax in your villa's private outdoor area and enjoy the tranquil beachfront setting.
day_by_day.evening: Book the Private Sunset Dolphin Cruise for this evening. Embark on an exclusive private dhoni boat cruise at sunset, sailing through the Indian Ocean while searching for spinner dolphins. Enjoy canapés and champagne on board as the sun melts into the horizon. A truly magical and romantic experience for couples.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast — order from the room service menu for a romantic morning in bed before your spa appointment (fresh fruit, pastries, eggs, and coffee)
meals.lunch: Resort's main restaurant — light post-spa lunch such as a Buddha bowl, grilled prawns, or a mezze platter (approx. $30–$45 per person)
meals.dinner: Dinner on return from the dolphin cruise at the resort's overwater restaurant or a casual dinner at the beach bar (approx. $50–$75 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Book the Underwater Spa Treatment for Two well in advance — ideally before your trip — as couples' slots fill up quickly, especially during peak honeymoon season. The Private Sunset Dolphin Cruise typically lasts 2–3 hours and departs around 5:00–5:30 PM. Bring a light wrap or layer for the boat as the ocean breeze can be cool after sunset. Confirm both bookings with the activities desk on Day 2.

day_by_day.morning: Take a morning snorkeling session independently at the house reef — by now you'll know the best entry points and spots. Focus on the deeper sections of the reef where larger marine life tends to congregate. Alternatively, join the resort's guided morning reef walk if offered at low tide.
day_by_day.afternoon: Participate in the Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class. Take a speedboat to the local inhabited island of Maafushi to experience authentic Maldivian culture. Explore traditional architecture, visit a local school or mosque (if permitted), browse local craft shops, and then join a hands-on cooking class where a local family teaches you to prepare traditional Maldivian dishes like garudhiya (fish broth), rihaakuru, and coconut-based curries.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by late afternoon. Freshen up and enjoy a quiet romantic dinner at the resort, trying the Maldivian-inspired dishes you learned about during your cooking class. Reflect on the cultural experience over a glass of wine on your beachfront terrace.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort — fuel up before the cultural excursion
meals.lunch: Lunch is typically included in the Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class — enjoy the dishes you helped prepare during the cooking class on Maafushi island
meals.dinner: Resort restaurant dinner — order Maldivian curry or seafood inspired by the day's cooking class (approx. $55–$80 per person)

day_by_day.notes: The Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class is a half-day excursion, typically running from midday to late afternoon. Dress modestly when visiting the local island — cover shoulders and knees out of respect for the local Muslim community. This is a wonderful way to add cultural depth to your honeymoon and connect with the authentic Maldivian way of life beyond the resort bubble.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a slow, romantic morning in your beachfront villa. Order in-villa breakfast and spend time watching the sunrise from your private terrace. Take a morning swim in the lagoon directly from the beach. This is a perfect rest and recharge morning after a busy few days.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the resort's water sports centre for a new adventure — try your hand at windsurfing, catamaran sailing, or a beginner's scuba diving discovery dive (PADI Discover Scuba Diving session, approx. $80–$120 per person). The discovery dive is an excellent option for non-certified divers who want to experience the underwater world more deeply than snorkeling allows.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy sundowners at the resort's overwater bar or beach bar. Then head to the resort's main restaurant for a special dinner — treat yourselves to a degustation or chef's tasting menu if available (a mid-range splurge night). Toast to your honeymoon.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast ordered via room service — a romantic morning treat
meals.lunch: Casual poolside or beach bar lunch — fish tacos, fresh salad, and tropical smoothies (approx. $25–$40 per person)
meals.dinner: Chef's tasting menu or à la carte dinner at the resort's signature restaurant — 4–5 courses featuring local seafood and international flavours (approx. $80–$120 per person with wine pairing)

day_by_day.notes: If you plan to do the discovery scuba dive, avoid heavy meals beforehand and stay well hydrated. The resort dive centre will provide a full safety briefing. March offers excellent underwater visibility (often 20–30 metres), making it an ideal time for a first dive experience. Book the tasting menu dinner in advance as seats are limited.

day_by_day.morning: Midpoint of your trip — celebrate with the Private Sandbank Picnic Dining experience. Be whisked away by speedboat to a secluded uninhabited sandbank in the middle of the turquoise lagoon. A private table, butler, and gourmet picnic setup await you surrounded by nothing but ocean and sky. Enjoy a champagne breakfast or brunch on the sandbank.
day_by_day.afternoon: After the sandbank experience, snorkel around the sandbank area (often rich in marine life) before returning to the resort. Spend a lazy afternoon at the pool or on the beach. Treat yourselves to an afternoon cocktail at the swim-up bar.
day_by_day.evening: Low-key evening at the resort. Enjoy a casual dinner at the beach bar or the resort's more relaxed dining venue. Take an evening stroll along the beach and stargaze from the shoreline — the Maldives offers some of the clearest night skies in the world, with minimal light pollution.

meals.breakfast: Gourmet champagne picnic breakfast/brunch on the private sandbank — included as part of the Private Sandbank Picnic Dining experience (fresh seafood, tropical fruits, artisan cheeses, pastries, and sparkling wine)
meals.lunch: Light snack on return from the sandbank — fresh fruit and a smoothie at the beach bar
meals.dinner: Casual beach bar dinner — grilled reef fish, salads, and fresh bread (approx. $40–$60 per person)

day_by_day.notes: The Private Sandbank Picnic Dining experience must be booked well in advance and is weather-dependent. The resort will confirm availability and conditions on the morning of the experience. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a hat, and sunglasses — sandbanks offer no shade. This is one of the most quintessential and Instagram-worthy Maldives experiences and a highlight of any honeymoon.

day_by_day.morning: Join a second Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari or arrange a private guided snorkeling tour with the resort's marine biologist. This time, focus on a different reef system or request a night snorkeling experience briefing for a future evening. Alternatively, explore the resort's house reef independently with newly gained confidence.
day_by_day.afternoon: Afternoon of pure relaxation — spend time in your beachfront villa, take a nap in the hammock, or enjoy the resort's infinity pool. If the resort offers a complimentary yoga or meditation session on the beach or overwater platform, this is a wonderful afternoon activity for couples.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic candlelit dinner on your private villa terrace — arrange this through the resort's concierge as an in-villa dining experience. Many resorts offer private dining setups with a dedicated butler and curated menu. This is a beautiful, intimate way to spend a honeymoon evening.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the main restaurant — try something new from the local section, such as fihunu mas (grilled fish) with roshi
meals.lunch: Overwater restaurant lunch — fresh sashimi, ceviche, or a light seafood pasta (approx. $35–$50 per person)
meals.dinner: Private in-villa candlelit dinner arranged by the concierge — 3-course set menu with wine (approx. $90–$130 per person, a special occasion splurge)

day_by_day.notes: Book the in-villa private dinner at least 2 days in advance through the concierge. Specify any dietary preferences or allergies. You can request special touches such as flower petals, candles, or a personalised menu for your honeymoon. This is an ideal evening for exchanging heartfelt moments and creating lasting memories.

day_by_day.morning: Try a new water sport — arrange a fishing excursion with the resort. Traditional Maldivian hand-line fishing (jigging) is a fun and authentic activity. Many resorts offer morning fishing trips where the catch can be prepared by the resort chef for your lunch. Departs around 6:00–7:00 AM for the best fishing.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return from fishing and enjoy your catch prepared by the resort chef — a truly farm-to-table (ocean-to-table) experience. Spend the afternoon exploring the resort's grounds, visiting the resort's boutique for souvenirs, or simply lounging on the beach with a novel.
day_by_day.evening: Join the Private Sunset Dolphin Cruise again if you'd like a second experience, or opt for a quiet sunset on the beach with a bottle of wine. Head to the resort's overwater restaurant for dinner and enjoy the twinkling lights reflecting on the calm lagoon.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before the fishing trip — grab a pastry, fruit, and coffee from the resort's early morning service
meals.lunch: Ocean-to-table lunch — your morning catch grilled or prepared ceviche-style by the resort chef (complimentary or at a nominal preparation fee)
meals.dinner: Overwater restaurant dinner — fresh seafood platter for two with a shared dessert (approx. $65–$90 per person)

day_by_day.notes: The fishing excursion typically departs very early — confirm timing with the activities desk. Bring sunscreen, a hat, and a light jacket for the early morning sea breeze. This is a wonderfully authentic and fun activity that gives you a taste of traditional Maldivian fishing culture. The catch-to-table experience is a highlight that many guests remember fondly.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicate the morning to a second Underwater Spa Treatment for Two — or choose individual treatments this time. Options might include a deep tissue massage, a hot stone treatment, or a traditional Maldivian healing ritual using local herbs and oils. The overwater spa setting makes any treatment feel extraordinary.
day_by_day.afternoon: Post-spa, enjoy a slow afternoon. Take a paddleboat or kayak out into the lagoon and simply float in the middle of the turquoise water. Bring snorkeling masks and explore any coral patches you spot. Return to the beach for golden hour relaxation.
day_by_day.evening: Explore the resort's evening entertainment if available — some resorts offer traditional Bodu Beru drumming performances, cultural shows, or live acoustic music. Enjoy dinner at a different restaurant or dining venue within the resort for variety.

meals.breakfast: À la carte breakfast at the resort — smashed avocado, poached eggs, and fresh tropical juice
meals.lunch: Beach bar lunch — light mezze, hummus, pita, and grilled halloumi (approx. $25–$40 per person)
meals.dinner: Resort's second dining venue (if available) or main restaurant — try a different cuisine option such as Asian fusion or Mediterranean (approx. $55–$80 per person)

day_by_day.notes: By Day 10, you may want to mix up your dining venues within the resort to keep things fresh. Ask the concierge about any special evening events or entertainment scheduled for this week. If the resort has a Bodu Beru performance, it's a wonderful cultural experience to witness — the traditional drumming and dancing is energetic and mesmerising.

day_by_day.morning: Adventure morning — arrange a dolphin watching excursion or a reef diving trip with the resort dive centre. If you completed the discovery dive earlier in the trip, you may feel confident enough to try a guided shallow dive. Alternatively, take a glass-bottom boat tour for a dry alternative to snorkeling that still showcases the reef's beauty.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and enjoy a long, luxurious afternoon at the pool. Order cocktails and snacks poolside. Take time to write postcards, journal about your honeymoon, or simply be present in the beauty of your surroundings. This is a perfect slow afternoon before your penultimate full day.
day_by_day.evening: Recreate your first dinner experience at the overwater restaurant — order the same dishes you loved or try the chef's special of the day. Reflect on the incredible journey of the past 11 days. Enjoy a nightcap at the overwater bar before a stroll back to your villa along the moonlit jetty.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast — revisit your favourite items from throughout the trip
meals.lunch: Poolside lunch — sharing platter of spring rolls, sliders, and tropical fruit skewers (approx. $30–$45 per person)
meals.dinner: Overwater restaurant — revisit favourite dishes from the trip or try the chef's weekly special (approx. $65–$90 per person)

day_by_day.notes: This is a good day to begin thinking about packing and organising any souvenirs or gifts purchased during the trip. Confirm your departure transfer details with the concierge — check the speedboat or seaplane schedule back to Malé for Day 13. Also, settle any outstanding charges or bookings with the resort's front desk today to avoid a rushed checkout.

day_by_day.morning: Final full morning in the Maldives — make it count. Wake up early for one last sunrise on the beach. Take a final snorkeling session at the house reef, saying goodbye to your favourite coral formations and fish friends. Spend time floating in the lagoon and soaking in the beauty of the crystal-clear water.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of the villa if required (standard checkout is typically 11:00 AM — request a late checkout through the concierge if your departure is in the evening). Spend the afternoon at the pool or beach using day-use facilities. Visit the resort boutique for any last-minute souvenirs — local handicrafts, reef-safe sunscreen, or resort-branded items make great keepsakes.
day_by_day.evening: Final farewell dinner at the resort — go all out for your last night. Book a special table, order your favourite dishes from the trip, and share a bottle of champagne or sparkling wine to toast your honeymoon. After dinner, take one last long walk along the beach under the stars and let the sound of the Indian Ocean waves be your soundtrack for the evening.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely final breakfast at the resort — order everything you loved throughout the trip as a final feast
meals.lunch: Casual beach bar farewell lunch — fish and chips, tropical salad, and a farewell cocktail (approx. $30–$45 per person)
meals.dinner: Special farewell dinner at the resort's signature restaurant — splurge on a memorable final meal with champagne (approx. $90–$130 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Arrange a late checkout with the concierge if your departure transfer is in the afternoon or evening of Day 13. Most resorts are accommodating for honeymoon guests. Pack the majority of your luggage tonight to make the morning of Day 13 stress-free. Leave out only essentials for the morning. Confirm your transfer time with the front desk one final time.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning — enjoy a last breakfast at the resort. Take one final dip in the lagoon or pool. Complete checkout formalities and settle any remaining bills. Say goodbye to the resort staff who have made your honeymoon unforgettable. Board your transfer speedboat or seaplane back to Malé International Airport.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Malé International Airport. Allow ample time for check-in, immigration, and security. Browse the duty-free shops for last-minute Maldivian souvenirs such as local spices, vanilla, or handicrafts. Relax in the departure lounge and relive your favourite moments from the past 13 days.
day_by_day.evening: Board your departure flight. Carry with you 13 days of extraordinary memories, a deeper connection with each other, and the promise of returning to this paradise someday.

meals.breakfast: Final breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort — savour every bite
meals.lunch: Airport restaurant or lounge — light meal before departure (approx. $15–$30 per person)
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or airport dining depending on departure time

day_by_day.notes: Ensure your transfer to Malé is booked and confirmed well in advance — allow at least 3–4 hours before your flight for the transfer, airport procedures, and potential delays. Keep your travel documents, resort receipts, and any duty-free purchases easily accessible. Carry any fragile souvenirs or liquid items (such as local honey or oils) in your checked luggage to comply with carry-on restrictions. Safe travels and congratulations on your honeymoon!

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Maldives Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dolphin Cruise
experiences.description: Embark on an exclusive private dhoni boat cruise at sunset, sailing through the Indian Ocean while spotting spinner dolphins in their natural habitat. Sip champagne with your partner as the sky turns golden, creating an unforgettable romantic moment perfect for honeymooners.

experiences.name: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari
experiences.description: Explore vibrant coral gardens teeming with sea turtles, reef sharks, manta rays, and hundreds of tropical fish species. A guided snorkeling safari takes you to the most pristine and biodiverse house reefs in the atolls, with equipment provided and a marine biologist on hand to narrate the underwater world.

experiences.name: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two
experiences.description: Indulge in a couples' spa ritual at a world-renowned overwater spa with a glass floor, allowing you to watch fish glide beneath you as you receive traditional Maldivian massages using coconut oil and local botanicals. This ultra-luxurious experience is the pinnacle of honeymoon pampering.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, South Ari Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Private Sandbank Picnic Dining
experiences.description: Be whisked away by speedboat to a secluded uninhabited sandbank in the middle of the turquoise lagoon. A private chef sets up a gourmet candlelit lunch with fresh Maldivian seafood, tropical fruits, and chilled wine — just you, your partner, and the endless ocean horizon.

experiences.name: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class
experiences.description: Visit the inhabited local island of Maafushi to experience authentic Maldivian culture — explore a traditional fishing village, visit a local mosque, and join a hands-on cooking class where you learn to prepare classic dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut) and garudhiya fish soup using age-old recipes.

day_by_day.morning: N/A – Flight in transit
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A – Flight in transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrival at Velana International Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Meet your dedicated Aegean Bliss Resort butler at the arrivals hall for a seamless VIP transfer. Board a private luxury speedboat for a scenic night transfer to the resort. Upon arrival, enjoy a private welcome ceremony with chilled champagne, tropical flower garlands, and a personal resort orientation by your butler.

meals.breakfast: N/A – In-flight
meals.lunch: N/A – In-flight
meals.dinner: Late-night welcome amenity platter arranged in your Beachfront Villa: chilled Moët & Chandon, fresh tropical fruit, artisan chocolates, and a selection of Maldivian canapés prepared by the resort's private chef.

day_by_day.notes: Arrival is late at night — no full activities scheduled. Ensure resort is pre-notified of late arrival for seamless check-in. Butler will have villa pre-decorated with rose petals and candles for a romantic honeymoon welcome. Pack a carry-on with essentials in case of any luggage delay.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely private breakfast served on your beachfront villa deck. Take a gentle orientation stroll along the resort's pristine white sand beach, exploring the lagoon's crystal-clear shallows. Your butler will brief you on all resort amenities, spa booking priorities, and activity scheduling for the week.
day_by_day.afternoon: First dip into paradise: Join the Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari — an expertly guided excursion exploring vibrant coral gardens teeming with sea turtles, reef sharks, manta rays, and hundreds of tropical fish species. Snorkeling gear, wetsuits, and underwater cameras are provided. Return to the villa for a refreshing outdoor rain shower and relaxation on your private sun loungers.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dolphin Cruise — embark on an exclusive private dhoni boat cruise at sunset, sailing through the warm Indian Ocean waters while sipping chilled Champagne and canapés. Watch wild spinner dolphins dance in the golden light of dusk before returning to the resort under a canopy of stars.

meals.breakfast: In-villa private breakfast: freshly baked pastries, tropical fruit platters, eggs cooked to order, fresh juices, and premium coffee — served on your beachfront deck.
meals.lunch: The Reef Restaurant at Aegean Bliss Resort — light Maldivian-inspired mezze: grilled reef fish, coconut ceviche, and chilled rosé wine with panoramic lagoon views.
meals.dinner: Aegean Bliss Overwater Fine Dining Restaurant — a 4-course set menu featuring line-caught tuna tartare, lobster bisque, pan-seared barramundi with saffron butter, and passion fruit soufflé. Paired wine flight recommended.

day_by_day.notes: Day 2 is intentionally relaxed to allow recovery from long-haul travel. Sunscreen (reef-safe), hats, and sunglasses are essential. Book spa and sandbank picnic experiences through your butler today to secure preferred dates.

day_by_day.morning: Indulge in the signature Underwater Spa Treatment for Two — a couples' spa ritual at the resort's world-renowned overwater spa featuring a glass floor, allowing you to watch marine life glide beneath you during your treatment. Choose from a Balinese couples' massage, hot stone therapy, or traditional Maldivian herbal wrap. The experience lasts approximately 2 hours.
day_by_day.afternoon: After your spa morning, enjoy a private catamaran sailing lesson with the resort's water sports team, or simply relax with complimentary kayaks and paddleboards in the calm resort lagoon. The beachfront villa's private pool is perfect for a peaceful afternoon soak.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic in-villa private dining experience: your butler and personal chef set up a candlelit table on your beach terrace with a bespoke 5-course menu, soft live acoustic guitar, and personalized floral arrangements. Toast to your honeymoon with a bottle of vintage Krug Champagne.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast: acai bowls, smoked salmon bagels, freshly squeezed juices, and a French press coffee selection.
meals.lunch: The Sandbar Grill — casual beachside dining with grilled Maldivian lobster, coconut prawn skewers, tropical salads, and fresh lime sodas.
meals.dinner: Private in-villa chef dinner on the beachfront terrace — 5-course bespoke menu with champagne pairing (pre-arranged through butler).

day_by_day.notes: Spa treatments should be booked 24–48 hours in advance. Inform the spa team of any allergies or preferences beforehand. The private chef dinner requires a minimum 24-hour notice — confirm with butler on Day 2.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a sunrise yoga and meditation session on your private beachfront deck led by the resort's resident wellness instructor. Follow with a refreshing swim in the villa's private infinity pool overlooking the lagoon. Enjoy a nourishing post-yoga breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class — board a speedboat to the inhabited local island of Maafushi for an immersive cultural experience. Explore a traditional Maldivian village, visit a local school, browse artisan workshops, and participate in an authentic Maldivian cooking class where you'll prepare traditional dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut), rihaakuru curry, and hedhikaa sweet snacks.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and unwind with sundowner cocktails at the overwater bar. Watch the sunset paint the sky in vivid oranges and pinks from the bar's signature swing seats suspended over the lagoon.

meals.breakfast: Post-yoga wellness breakfast: smoothie bowls, avocado toast with poached eggs, herbal teas, and cold-pressed juices at the resort's wellness café.
meals.lunch: Authentic Maldivian lunch on Maafushi island — freshly prepared local dishes from your cooking class, served communally with island residents.
meals.dinner: Aegean Bliss Teppanyaki & Asian Fusion Restaurant — chef's table omakase experience featuring wagyu beef, black truffle gyoza, miso-glazed sea bass, and yuzu sorbet. Sake pairing available.

day_by_day.notes: The cultural tour requires modest dress — bring a light cover-up and closed shoes for village exploration. This is a wonderful opportunity to purchase authentic Maldivian lacquerwork, woven mats, and handmade jewelry as keepsakes.

day_by_day.morning: Private Sandbank Picnic Dining — be whisked away by speedboat to a secluded uninhabited sandbank in the middle of the turquoise lagoon. Arrive to find a beautifully styled private table set with linen, crystal glassware, and a gourmet picnic spread prepared by the resort's chef. Spend the morning swimming, sunbathing, and enjoying absolute seclusion in paradise.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a leisurely afternoon. Explore the resort's house reef with a self-guided snorkel session — the house reef is accessible directly from the beach and is home to sea turtles, vibrant coral formations, and colorful reef fish. Relax with a chilled coconut on your villa's sun deck.
day_by_day.evening: Stargazing experience on the resort's private observatory deck with the resort's resident astronomer, who will guide you through the Southern Hemisphere's spectacular night sky using high-powered telescopes. Conclude the evening with a nightcap of aged rum and chocolate at the overwater lounge.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast: eggs Benedict, freshly baked croissants, tropical fruit, and a Champagne mimosa to start the sandbank day in style.
meals.lunch: Gourmet sandbank picnic — chilled seafood platter (lobster, tiger prawns, oysters), artisan cheese board, fresh salads, and a bottle of chilled Whispering Angel rosé, served on the private sandbank.
meals.dinner: The Lagoon Restaurant — open-air overwater dining with a rotating seasonal menu. Tonight's highlight: whole grilled Maldivian reef fish with lemongrass and kaffir lime, accompanied by a curated white Burgundy selection.

day_by_day.notes: The sandbank picnic is weather-dependent and subject to sea conditions. Your butler will confirm suitability the evening before. Apply reef-safe sunscreen generously — sandbank exposure offers no shade. This is the perfect setting for a surprise romantic gesture or proposal if applicable.

day_by_day.morning: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari (second session) — revisit the vibrant coral gardens with a focus on a different reef section, this time with an underwater photographer accompanying the group to capture professional-quality images and videos of your snorkeling experience. Prints and a digital gallery will be delivered to your villa.
day_by_day.afternoon: Indulge in an afternoon of pure luxury: book a private cabana at the resort's adults-only infinity pool with dedicated pool butler service. Enjoy chilled towels, fresh fruit skewers, and a curated cocktail menu. Alternatively, explore the resort's boutique for Maldivian crafts, designer swimwear, and exclusive resort-branded keepsakes.
day_by_day.evening: Overwater bungalow romantic dinner — the resort sets up a private floating dining table on a pontoon over the lagoon, illuminated by lanterns and surrounded by the gentle sound of the ocean. A violinist serenades you throughout the meal.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast: full English/American breakfast with smoked salmon, avocado, grilled tomatoes, premium cold cuts, freshly baked bread, and barista coffee.
meals.lunch: Pool cabana service — gourmet burgers with truffle fries, lobster rolls, fresh coconut water, and a chilled Aperol Spritz.
meals.dinner: Private overwater pontoon dinner — 6-course tasting menu: amuse-bouche, chilled gazpacho, seared scallops, lobster thermidor, mango sorbet palate cleanser, wagyu tenderloin, and a decadent chocolate fondant with vanilla ice cream. Paired wine flight included.

day_by_day.notes: Book the underwater photographer at least 48 hours in advance through the resort's dive center. The overwater pontoon dinner is one of the resort's most exclusive experiences — confirm with butler well in advance and specify any dietary requirements.

day_by_day.morning: Mid-trip wellness morning: begin with a 60-minute private couples' stretch and breathwork session on the beach, followed by a guided meditation at the resort's garden sanctuary. Spend the rest of the morning floating in your villa's private pool and journaling in the tranquil surroundings.
day_by_day.afternoon: Big game fishing excursion on a private chartered vessel — head into deeper Indian Ocean waters for an exhilarating sport fishing experience targeting yellowfin tuna, wahoo, and dorado. The resort's expert fishing guide accompanies you. Catch-and-release is practiced; however, selected catches can be prepared by the resort chef for dinner.
day_by_day.evening: Casual sundowner evening at the resort's beachfront fire pit — roast marshmallows, sip artisan cocktails, and enjoy a curated charcuterie and cheese board under the stars. A perfect low-key evening after an active afternoon.

meals.breakfast: Wellness café: green smoothies, overnight oats with mango and coconut, whole grain toast with almond butter, and detox herbal teas.
meals.lunch: On-board the fishing vessel: a packed gourmet picnic lunch prepared by the resort chef — sandwiches, fresh salads, energy bars, and chilled beverages.
meals.dinner: The Chef's Table at Aegean Bliss — if you caught fish, the head chef prepares it tableside in a personalized 4-course dinner. Otherwise, enjoy the chef's seasonal tasting menu with optional wine pairing.

day_by_day.notes: Sport fishing requires a minimum 4-hour booking. Motion sickness medication is recommended if sensitive to open ocean swells. The resort requires 24-hour notice to prepare your catch as dinner — inform your butler immediately upon return.

day_by_day.morning: Private scuba diving introduction or certified dive — the resort's PADI-certified dive center offers a Discover Scuba experience for non-divers or guided dives for certified divers. Explore the stunning house reef at depth, encountering sea turtles, Napoleon wrasse, and vibrant coral walls. Two-tank dives available for certified divers.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the villa for a leisurely afternoon. Enjoy an in-villa couples' foot ritual — a complimentary service offered by the resort's spa team who come directly to your villa. Relax on your beachfront sun loungers with chilled tropical cocktails and a selection of books from the resort's library.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dolphin Cruise (second experience) — this time, enjoy the cruise with a private chef on board who prepares freshly grilled seafood canapés as you sail. Watch the sunset and dolphin pods in absolute privacy.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast: French toast with caramelized banana, Greek yogurt parfait, smoked salmon blinis, fresh juices, and premium espresso.
meals.lunch: The Reef Restaurant — post-dive refueling with a hearty grilled fish and vegetable platter, quinoa salad, fresh coconut water, and tropical fruit.
meals.dinner: Aegean Bliss Overwater Fine Dining — tonight's special: a Maldivian-inspired degustation menu featuring local reef fish, coconut-based curries, and traditional Maldivian desserts reimagined with fine-dining technique.

day_by_day.notes: Non-swimmers can enjoy the resort's glass-bottom boat tour as an alternative to snorkeling or diving. Certified divers should bring their PADI/NAUI certification cards. The dive center recommends no flying within 18 hours of diving — keep this in mind for departure planning.

day_by_day.morning: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two (second session) — revisit the iconic overwater spa, this time choosing different treatments: try the resort's signature 'Ocean Ritual' featuring a sea salt body scrub, warm coconut oil wrap, and a 90-minute deep tissue couples' massage with panoramic glass-floor ocean views.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private sailing catamaran excursion — the resort's luxury catamaran takes you on a half-day private sail around the atoll, stopping at a secluded snorkeling spot and a remote sandbank for a swim. Chilled beverages and fresh fruit are served on board.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic in-villa movie night under the stars — the resort sets up an outdoor cinema on your private beach terrace with a projector, plush bean bags, a cashmere throw, and a gourmet popcorn and dessert station. Choose from a curated film selection.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast: eggs any style, freshly baked pastries, tropical smoothie bowls, and a Champagne breakfast cocktail.
meals.lunch: On the catamaran: a gourmet picnic lunch — chilled seafood, artisan sandwiches, tropical salads, fresh coconut, and sparkling water.
meals.dinner: In-villa private dining: a curated 4-course menu delivered and set up by your butler — mushroom velouté, burrata salad, grilled lobster with garlic butter, and a chocolate and raspberry tart.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm the outdoor cinema setup with your butler by midday. The catamaran sail is subject to weather conditions. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a hat, and a light layer for the evening sea breeze.

day_by_day.morning: Island hopping adventure — your butler arranges a private speedboat tour to three nearby uninhabited islands. Explore pristine beaches, search for shells, and snorkel at a different coral garden from a new perspective. The resort's marine biologist accompanies you to provide expert insights on the local ecosystem.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and enjoy a relaxed afternoon at the overwater hammock garden — a secluded area of the resort with hammocks strung between stilts over the lagoon. Sip fresh coconut water and read, or simply drift in the gentle ocean breeze.
day_by_day.evening: Maldivian cultural dinner experience at the resort — the culinary team hosts a special Maldivian feast on the beach featuring traditional bodu beru drumming performances, fire dancing, and a lavish spread of authentic Maldivian cuisine. Dress code: resort elegant.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast: acai and granola bowls, freshly squeezed orange juice, croissants, and a selection of artisan jams and preserves.
meals.lunch: Packed gourmet picnic for the island hopping tour — gourmet wraps, fruit skewers, energy bars, and chilled sparkling water.
meals.dinner: Maldivian cultural beach dinner — traditional dishes including garudhiya (tuna broth), mas riha (fish curry), roshi (flatbread), coconut sambol, and traditional Maldivian sweets. Non-alcoholic traditional drinks and premium cocktails available.

day_by_day.notes: The cultural dinner is a resort-wide event — reserve your seating in advance. The island hopping tour requires early departure (8:00 AM) to maximize time at each location. Bring an underwater camera for the snorkeling stops.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise paddleboard yoga session — join the resort's wellness instructor for a unique paddleboard yoga class on the calm lagoon at sunrise. This is a challenging yet deeply meditative experience with breathtaking golden light over the water. Follow with a refreshing lagoon swim.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private Sandbank Picnic Dining (second experience) — a different sandbank location is selected for a more intimate afternoon. This time, the butler arranges a Champagne and oyster tasting on the sandbank, followed by a couples' sunset photography session with the resort's professional photographer.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell-approaching romantic dinner at the resort's most exclusive table — the 'Nest' — an elevated private dining pod perched above the lagoon, accessible only by a private walkway. Dinner is a fully bespoke experience designed by the head chef based on your preferences.

meals.breakfast: Post-yoga wellness breakfast: protein smoothies, avocado toast, poached eggs, and herbal teas at the wellness café.
meals.lunch: Sandbank champagne and oyster tasting — freshly shucked oysters, chilled tiger prawns, artisan bread, and a bottle of Louis Roederer Cristal.
meals.dinner: The Nest private dining pod — fully bespoke 7-course tasting menu designed by the head chef: personalized to your tastes and dietary preferences, with optional wine pairing curated by the resort sommelier.

day_by_day.notes: The Nest is the resort's most exclusive dining venue with only one seating per evening — book on Day 1 or 2 to secure availability. The couples' photography session on the sandbank will yield professional prints delivered to your villa as a keepsake.

day_by_day.morning: Final snorkeling adventure — take one last Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari, this time focusing on the deeper outer reef where manta rays and whale sharks (seasonal) are more commonly spotted. The resort's marine biologist leads this specialized session.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spa afternoon: book individual treatments at the overwater spa — choose from a variety of massages, facials, body wraps, and hydrotherapy treatments. Spend the remainder of the afternoon packing, organizing keepsakes, and enjoying your villa for the last full afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Private farewell dinner on the beach — your butler orchestrates a final magical evening with a bespoke tablescape on the private beach outside your villa, complete with tiki torches, floral arrangements, and a personalized menu. The resort's sommelier selects a special bottle from the cellar to mark the occasion.

meals.breakfast: Celebratory in-villa breakfast: Eggs Benedict with truffle hollandaise, smoked salmon, freshly baked pastries, fresh fruit, and a Champagne toast.
meals.lunch: The Sandbar Grill — a relaxed final lunch with grilled fish tacos, coconut shrimp, fresh salads, and tropical mocktails.
meals.dinner: Private farewell beach dinner — 5-course personalized menu: oysters and caviar, lobster bisque, mango and prawn salad, grilled whole lobster with herb butter, and a custom honeymoon celebration cake prepared by the resort's pastry chef.

day_by_day.notes: Request the resort to prepare a personalized honeymoon memory book — many luxury Maldivian resorts offer this complimentary service with photos taken throughout your stay. Confirm checkout time and departure transfer arrangements with your butler this evening.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise on the beachfront — wake early for one last sunrise over the Indian Ocean from your villa's private deck. Enjoy a leisurely final breakfast and take a slow walk along the resort's beach, collecting shells and soaking in the last moments of paradise.
day_by_day.afternoon: Checkout and departure — your dedicated butler oversees all luggage handling and resort checkout formalities. Board the private luxury speedboat transfer back to Velana International Airport. Your butler accompanies you to the jetty and ensures a seamless, memorable farewell.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Velana International Airport — the resort's airport concierge assists with check-in and fast-track procedures. Reflect on 13 extraordinary days in paradise as you board your flight home.

meals.breakfast: Final in-villa breakfast: a grand spread of all your favorite items from the past 13 days — curated by your butler as a personalized farewell gesture. Champagne toast to an unforgettable honeymoon.
meals.lunch: Light pre-departure lunch at the resort's café before checkout — fresh sandwiches, tropical fruit, and iced coffee.
meals.dinner: Airport lounge dining or in-flight — the resort can arrange a gourmet departure hamper with Maldivian treats, chocolates, and a bottle of Champagne to enjoy on your journey home.

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3 hours before your flight for the speedboat transfer and airport check-in. Collect all purchased resort credits, spa receipts, and activity vouchers for expense records. The resort's concierge can arrange duty-free shopping assistance at the airport. Ensure all underwater photography files and printed keepsakes are safely packed in carry-on luggage.
